links.outcome: Documentation time, after-hours EMR time, and provider burnout after ambient scribe deployment
links.effect: High users: 21% decrease in daily note time (-13.6 min), 13% decrease in pajama time (-3.6 min). Providers with no burnout symptoms rose 22% (49.4%), but the burnout difference was not significant.
links.quote: This ambient AI scribe decreased the time providers spent writing notes in the clinic and decreased time spent in the EMR outside of work hours.

links.outcome: Patient experience ('provider listened to me' satisfaction scores) after ambient AI use
links.effect: No significant effect on patient satisfaction scores (P=.39).
links.quote: Patient experience, as measured by "provider listened to me" scores on patient satisfaction surveys, was not significantly affected by ambient AI use (P=.39).

screen.reason: Prospective real-world pilot study evaluating the implementation of an ambient AI scribe (Abridge) in an ambulatory setting, measuring effects on documentation time, burnout, and patient satisfaction, but not comparing specific guardrail configurations or deployment practices.
